title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 Totalisht I Investuar, Ne Allias !
description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2-te te nje pallati ekzistues te mireadministruar pa ashensor dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes, kendi gatimit i vecuar, dy dhomat e gjumit, nje depo dhe tualeti me dritare. Prona eshte totalisht e investuar dhe eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per banim edhe per investim pasi kekesat per qira jane te larta. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: 2+1 Fully Invested Apartment for sale, in Allias!
description_en: The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of an existing well-managed building without an elevator and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, a storage room and a bathroom with a window. The property is fully invested and is a very good opportunity for both housing and investment as the rents are high. The property has full mortgage documentation.
